posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy admits the Steelers offensive line had protection challenges against the Browns: “We had some protection challenges. They did a good job up front. It was a five-man pressure, man-to-man game. They established that right from the beginning. That's the challenge that we went up against all night. It was herky-jerky. When you play those games, it's who is going to make the big play. You have to step out of tackles, you have to separate, you have to give him time to get through the progression. I think it was an aggressive game plan by them. I kind of expected some of it, but I thought it was a very competitive environment tonight, and we were one play short.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Mike McCarthy emphasized situational football and the Steelers just came up short: “I think my biggest disappointment that I expressed to the team would be, I just believe that you get what you emphasize in this league. We put a tremendous amount of time and energy into situational football, the calls in those situations. And we came up short when it counted most in the two-minute at the end of the game. I think the guys did a great job battling through the ups and downs of it. Playing from behind once they took the lead, after we had established the lead early. It's a back-and-forth division game, which I think is what you'd expect. The situational football I think we've got to be a little bit better.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: CBS Sports Ryan Wilson thinks the Steelers are the worst team in the AFC North: “They’re not a good football team. The problem now is you can’t blame Mike Tomlin. Because Steelers fans didn’t run him out, he decided to retire. But that was the old diatribe we’d hear every single year since 2016, the last time they won a playoff game. ‘Winning nine games is great, but we don’t want to get blown out in the playoffs.’ I think they have been a victim of their own success in that they’ve never had an opportunity to reset and get that franchise quarterback. They’re not a good team. They are the worst team in the division. I don’t even think you can argue that point.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text:
Dolphins star RB De’Von Achane suffered a torn ACL, sources tell me and Adam Schefter, and he’s out for the season.

In an already trying season for Miami, the team loses Achane.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Baker Mayfield is still expected to miss some time, as he'll need to be able to grip a ball. Jalon Daniels will start going forward, but Mayfield's good news helps him back on the field sooner.

posts.text: Sources: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield suffered a dislocated thumb but got good news on the MRI. No fracture and no ligament or tendon damage.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Sources: Panthers star CB Jaycee Horn suffered a torn quad and is out indefinitely. One of the game's best. 

Horn will seek a second opinion, but he's headed for Injured Reserve and could be lost for the season.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Falcons placed CB A.J. Terrell on injured reserve.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks RB Jadarian Price, who left today’s game at Arizona with a chest injury, had X-rays that came back negative. More tests Monday, but there’s optimism he avoided any significant injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Commanders have officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels with a left elbow injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Ladd McConkey is officially active.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Deshaun Watson and Baker Mayfield meet on Sunday in Tampa for the first time since one of the biggest trades, and wildest weeks, in NFL history. 

An in-depth look at how it happened, and the fallout for all involved, in my latest dispatch at The Sweep:

tompelissero.substack.com/p/week-2-ins...

posts.author: nfl.com
posts.text: NFL Week 2 injury report: Player statuses for all 16 games - nfl.com

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Jets WR Omar Cooper Jr. is believed to have suffered a high ankle sprain in today’s win over Tennessee, sources say. 

X-rays were negative. Cooper, the first-round pick, will have an MRI on Monday to determine the extent of the injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Myles Garrett is now set to miss games against the Giants, Broncos, Eagles and Bills. L.A. hosts the Cardinals in Week 6.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Rams star Myles Garrett will undergo arthroscopic surgery on his ailing knee and is headed to injured reserve, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Garrett has been dealing with lower-leg pain and wasn’t himself in Thursday’s opener. The hope is he’s back in four weeks.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Sources: The #Seahawks are signing veteran QB Drew Lock, bringing him back to Seattle for a second stint. He will backup Sam Darnold.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Sources: Colorado QB Shedeur Sanders is scheduled to visit the #Raiders early next week. 

Las Vegas holds the No. 6 pick in the draft. They have been doing work on QBs and have other QB prospects also coming into their building.

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text: Spoke with an NFL assistant GM about Alabama QB Jalen Milroe: “He’s one of the most intriguing guys in the entire draft. There’s a narrative that he’s just a running quarterback, but that’s way off...

posts.author: schultzreport.bsky.social
posts.text:
Former #Bucs OC Byron Leftwich is back in coaching as he is joining Deion Sanders’ staff at Colorado.

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: #Bears GM Ryan Poles, via team statement: “This morning, after meeting with George and Kevin, we informed Matt of our decision to move in a different direction with the leadership of our football team and the head coaching position…”

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text:
Matt Eberflus at 9:30a: “I’m confident I’ll be prepping for SF and coaching this team.”

Matt Eberflus at noon: FIRED.

(Why would the #Bears let that man address reporters, knowing he wouldn’t make it thru the week, let alone the day?)

posts.author: kimberleymartin.bsky.social
posts.text: Will this game be over before I have to leave for Cincinnati on Saturday 🫠

posts.author: jglazer.bsky.social
posts.text: Ok, finally dipping my toe in these waters. I realllllly hope this is way less of a negative cesspool than X!
